Message:
mwl8k: pci BAR mapping changes

Map BAR0 as well, as we need to write to it during init on some chips.

Also, if BAR0 is a 64bit BAR, the register BAR becomes BAR2, so try
mapping BAR2 if mapping BAR1 fails.
